annotations.title: Calldata, Revert Error & Failed Tx Decoder (Zero API Key)

description: [ZERO API KEY REQUIRED] Universal Calldata, Custom Revert Error & Failed Transaction Post-Mortem Decoder. Accepts raw hex calldata/revert bytes (0x...) OR a 66-char transaction hash (0x...), replays reverted transactions at their exact block, decodes 4-byte signatures & parameters, and flags malicious approvals (approve / permit / setApprovalForAll).

input.description: Raw hex calldata/revert error (0x...) OR 66-char transaction hash (0x...)

name: decode_calldata_or_failed_tx
